## BackendUnavailableError class

Thrown when no configured backend is available or reachable. Mirrors the pure-TypeScript `vaultkeeper` library's `BackendUnavailableError`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare class BackendUnavailableError extends VaultError 
```
**Extends:** [VaultError](./wasm.vaulterror.md)
